title: fix(import): CSV import gaps — field mapping + per-record AuditLog + required-field validation
head: fix/import-csv-gaps
body:
## Scope: Fix production-code gaps from G2 CSV E2E (per Release Owner direction)

Fixes the 3 production-code gaps that were BLOCKING G2 full PASS (documented in PR #16 CSV E2E evidence `08-csv-e2e-evidence.txt`):

1. **Field mapping** — `requestId` + `siteCode` now read from CSV and populated in WorkOrder (was null)
2. **Per-record AuditLog** — both `importWorkOrders` (CSV path) and `importAppsScriptWorkOrders` (Apps Script path) now call `logAudit` per WorkOrder created (action=`WORK_ORDER_IMPORT`, entity=`WorkOrder`, with `siteCode` + `actor=system`)
3. **Required-field validation** — `requestId` is now required; rows missing `requestId` are rejected (added to errors, not created)

### Paths fixed

- `importWorkOrders` (CSV path, `jobType=work-order`): adds `requestId`/`siteCode` mapping + `logAudit` per record + `requestId` required validation
- `importAppsScriptWorkOrders` (Apps Script path): adds `siteCode` to create data + `logAudit` per record + `requestId` required (was optional)

### CSV E2E test result (fail-closed): 5/5 PASSED

| Test | Result | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 1a HTTP 201 | ✅ PASS | HTTP 201 + ImportJob status=completed, processedRows=2 |
| 1b field mapping | ✅ PASS | 2 WorkOrders created, requestId populated 2/2, siteCode populated 2/2 |
| 2 AuditLog per-record | ✅ PASS | 2 entries (siteCode=HQ + UDH, actor=system, action=WORK_ORDER_IMPORT) |
| 3 invalid CSV rejection | ✅ PASS | missing requestId → rejected (400+) |
| 4 route structure | ✅ PASS | POST + logAudit + CSV parse + jobType validation |

### Constraints preserved

- B4 frozen files: NOT touched (0-diff verified vs `ee75164`)
- `SYNC_RUN`: NOT added (auth-shared.ts has 0 occurrences)
- Production secrets: NOT committed

### Gate impact

This PR closes the production-code gaps that were BLOCKING G2 full PASS. Once merged + Audit re-reviews PR #16 with this fix, G2 may proceed to full PASS (pending other blockers: Issue #15 credential rotation + operational evidence from Release Owner).

### References

- PR #16 (G2 staging evidence, Remediation Pass 3): https://github.com/nikorn2527-stack/ITAM-NextJS/pull/16
- Issue #15 (credential rotation — Release Owner): https://github.com/nikorn2527-stack/ITAM-NextJS/issues/15
- Issue #14 (Audit Path B re-review): https://github.com/nikorn2527-stack/ITAM-NextJS/issues/14

G3 Canary + Production remain BLOCKED (pending G2 full PASS + Release Owner operational evidence).
